name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially a systems administrator for a large financial institution in Montreal, she found herself drawn to the data-driven world of racing through a client project. The sheer volume of information, the real-time analysis, and the direct impact of IT infrastructure on performance captivated her. She transitioned to a smaller racing team, cutting her teeth on the fast-paced demands of trackside support.

Now at Arrow McLaren, Isabelle thrives on optimizing IT infrastructure to give the team a competitive edge. She is known for her rigorous approach and unwavering focus on reliability. While she appreciates collaboration, she is ultimately driven by the need to see her systems performing flawlessly, often working independently to achieve this goal. Her ability to see the big picture, understanding how every line of code and server configuration affects the car on the track, sets her apart.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, usually pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Isabelle is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even to meetings.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, regardless of the environment.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
